description: Single-panel strip/interval plot composed of many short, thin vertical ticks arranged in several horizontal bands (rows) across the y-direction; ticks vary in x-position and cluster at certain ranges. Axes, labels, and gridlines ignored.

primary.explanation: Many short vertical tick lines positioned by continuous x and banded y; modeled as individual items.
